rules.at_freeze: overall_rank, total_points, value, bank = the history row of the last finished GW; chips_used = history chips with event <= that GW; nothing from later GWs is read
rules.privacy: entry ids and FPL numbers only: no names, no regions
rules.random: candidate ids drawn uniformly without replacement from 1..total_players (bootstrap at the freeze); kept if entry/{id}/history/ exists (404 = not_found) and has a row for each of the last 3 finished gameweeks (else inactive); the first 1500 kept in draw order
rules.scoring: per finished, data-checked GW after the freeze GW: net points = points - event_transfers_cost; members are never dropped (no_row / not_found rows keep empty points)
rules.top10k: all 200 pages of the top 10000 of leagues-classic/314 fetched in 2 snapshots (the order within ties changes between fetches); canonical list = the distinct entries with rank <= 10000 seen in any snapshot, ordered by (rank, entry id), cut at 10000; 1500 positions drawn uniformly without replacement from 1..len(list); no activity rule

units: value and bank in tenths of a million (FPL API units)
